::: {tbl-colwidths="[15,20,15,50]"}
| **Symbol**                   | **Definition**                 | **Unit**      | **Notes**                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
|:-----------------------------|:-------------------------------|:--------------|:---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **$N_{\text{GPU}}$**         | **Accelerator Count**          | Integer       | Number of accelerators in one job.                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **$M_{\text{activations}}$** | **Activation Memory**          | bytes         | Retained activations for the backward pass or serving intermediates.                                                                                                                                                       |
| **$I$**                      | **Arithmetic Intensity**       | FLOP/byte     | Workload FLOPs per byte moved. The Roofline Model uses $I$ as the independent variable.                                                                                                                                    |
| **$\lambda_{\text{arr}}$**   | **Arrival Rate**               | requests/s    | Request arrival rate. The subscript keeps bare $\lambda$ free for fitted sensitivities.                                                                                                                                    |
| **$R_{\text{attain}}$**      | **Attainable Compute Rate**    | FLOP/s        | Roofline bound: $\AttainableComputeRate \leq \min(\PeakRate, I \times \Bandwidth)$. Uses $R$, not $T$, because this quantity is a rate.                                                                                    |
| **$T_{\text{svc}}(B)$**      | **Batch Service Time**         | seconds       | Time to serve a batch of size $B$.                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **$r_{\text{comp}}$**        | **Compression Ratio**          | Dimensionless | Uncompressed size divided by compressed size. A compressed payload has $1/\CompressionRatio$ of the uncompressed size; the subscript avoids bare $C$ collisions.                                                           |
| **$\mu_{\text{eff}}(B)$**    | **Effective Service Rate**     | requests/s    | Batched service rate, typically $\EffectiveServiceRate = B/\BatchServiceTimeSvc$. The unbatched service rate is $\mu = \mu_{\text{eff}}(1)$.                                                                               |
| **$s_{\text{elem}}$**        | **Element Storage Size**       | bytes/element | Bytes per stored tensor element.                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **$L_{\text{lat, total}}$**  | **End-to-End Request Latency** | seconds       | Request-path latency budget, $L_{\text{lat,network}} + L_{\text{lat,pre}} + L_{\text{lat,infer}} + L_{\text{lat,post}} + L_{\text{lat,queue}}$. $\RequestTimeInSystemLat$ covers only the time inside the serving system.  |
| **$M_{\text{gradients}}$**   | **Gradient Memory**            | bytes         | Memory occupied by stored gradients.                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **$T_{\text{compute}}$**     | **Iron-Law Term Times**        | seconds       | The memory and compute terms of the iron law, $\DataVolume/\Bandwidth$ and $O/(\PeakRate \cdot \EfficiencyHw)$.                                                                                                            |
| **$s_{\text{loss}}$**        | **Loss-Scale Factor**          | Dimensionless | Multiplier applied to the loss in reduced-precision training so small gradients stay representable.                                                                                                                        |
| **$\text{MFU}$**             | **Model FLOPs Utilization**    | Dimensionless | Useful model FLOP/s divided by available peak FLOP/s. Text acronym avoids overloading $\eta$.                                                                                                                              |
| **$M_{\text{optimizer}}$**   | **Optimizer-State Memory**     | bytes         | Momentum, variance, master weights, and related optimizer buffers.                                                                                                                                                         |
| **$Q_{\text{req}}$**         | **Request Concurrency**        | requests      | Average in-flight requests in a stable serving system ($\RequestConcurrency = \ArrivalRate \cdot \RequestTimeInSystemLat$ via Little's Law). Avoids overloading $N$, which counts devices, elements, or samples elsewhere. |
| **$T_{\text{lat}}$**         | **Request Time in System**     | seconds       | End-to-end queueing/serving latency for Little's Law. Distinct from $\Latency$, the fixed-latency term in the iron law.                                                                                                    |
| **$I_{\text{ridge}}$**       | **Roofline Ridge Point**       | FLOP/byte     | $\RooflineRidgePoint = \PeakRate/\Bandwidth$. Prefer this explicit form over starred shorthand so the meaning remains clear in prose.                                                                                      |
| **$s_{\text{sample}}$**      | **Sample Storage Size**        | bytes/sample  | Bytes per stored training or serving sample.                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **$\rho_{\text{serv}}$**     | **Serving Utilization**        | Dimensionless | Queue/server utilization. The subscript keeps bare $\rho$ free for other ratio models.                                                                                                                                     |
| **$M_{\text{total}}$**       | **Total Memory Footprint**     | bytes         | Sum of explicit memory components; avoids bare $M$ ambiguity.                                                                                                                                                              |
:::
